title: Update treasury execution permissions
body: This proposal changes the treasury Safe approval threshold from 4/7 to 3/5. It grants upgrade authority to 0x2222222222222222222222222222222222222222 and transfers the pause role to 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333. Execution depends on two separate onchain transactions. Reversing the authority transfer requires a later governance action.
